notes.title: Ending cutscene fix.
notes.content:
The ending cutscene was broken where it would softlock the player and not play any audio.

It is fixed.

notes.title: Major quality of game update.
notes.content:
[h1]Bigger Update Than Usually Incoming![/h1]
Hey,
so the game so far was pretty bland and im working on fixing it.

Today i've managed to do some visual as well as logic changes to the game.

[h1]AI Navigation[/h1]
I think the biggest logic change has to be AI navigation.
The way the surface works was changed, the rats still can't get out of the house, unless they are chasing you. Also the cultists can now go to the house, which means that during the final chase, you can now enter the house and so can they.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128693/bac75e26ee32d399a7bf9142b3737e6da620536f.png[/img]

The rats are also 5 times faster!
Which means its now easier to die.

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]
I also changed so you need to turn on the power before watching the tape.
Which makes sense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128693/c7ceb38f39489ab11ea49b2fa6ae66eec5c6cd93.png[/img]

Couple of ambiance effects were changed.
Like for example:
[list]
[*] There is no more ambiance in the attic.
[*] There is a drowsy ambiance added to the ending cutscene.
[*] The ambiance turns off before the Big Rat jumpscare.
[*] More effects when getting chased.
[*] etc.
[/list]

[h1]Plans[/h1]
I still have a lot planned for this game.

Like i really want to do a whole ambiance rework since that was planned to be the most scary part of the game, but with the time limit that i had on the game, i just couldn't do it.

I also want to add more jumpscares and ways to die, as well as custscenes.

[h1]That's a wrap![/h1]
That's pretty much it.

Thank you guys so much for playing RERODENT and stay on the look out for future updates!

Scinacz.

notes.title: Massive Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello,
I'm back once again to fix some of the major bugs in the game.

[b]Here is a list of what i changed/fixed:[/b]
- The car cutscene now takes less time.
- Increased the angle that the player can look in the car to make sure no one gets soft locked.
- Kitchen Knfie now translates to different languages.
- The "[i]rope[/i]" and the "[i]rope & hook[/i]" items have different collisions now to make sure they dont roll away.
- Loading a save without exiting the game no longer makes the game be in daylight and no longer teleports you back to the car.

[b]Translations fixed:[/b]
  French translation:
- The save button is now "[i]sauvegarder[/i]" instead of "[i]sauvegarde[/i]".
- The bathroom key is now "[i]clé de la salle de bain[/i]".
- The quest for opening the toilet and bathroom is switched to be correct with what the player is suppose to do.
- The VHS drawer key is now "[i]clé du tiroir à VHS[/i]."
- The "votre clé office" part in the VHS's subtitles are changed to la "[i]clé de votre bureau[/i]".
- The attic closet key is now "[i]clé du placard du grenier[/i]"
- Crowbar is now "[i]pied-de-biche[/i]".
- The special thanks text during the ending is now translated to "[i]remerciements spéciaux[/i]".

I hope yall have fun!
Scinacz.

notes.title: Major after release bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hey sooo i have seen the videos and its bad.

There were a lot of bugs, making the game beatable in 10 minutes which is a big no no.
So im fixed them as soon as i could.
Fixed:
- You can no longer grab story related items before they are suppose to be grabbed.
- The crowbar and the gun no longer pass through objects.
- The pause menu no longer soft locks the game.
- You can no longer 360 backwards long jump into the basement stairs to pass through.

I also added a tutorial text for Saving since no one really got it.

That would be all.
Thank yall so much for the support!
